control.source: complete G2 seed42 run, reused rather than retrained
control.reuse_condition: Each G3 arm must reproduce every logged G2 coverage_mix loss and gradient norm exactly before its first changed optimizer step; otherwise no paired claim.

model.scope: Public pinned weights; LFS hashes checked; no training

training.base: fresh same pinned base for both arms, T on, M off
training.context_recipe: G2 coverage_mix exposures; only infeasible stop exposures change context
training.curriculum: first epoch category/error-balanced scenario assignment; reverse every scenario in epoch2

evaluation.scope: Reused development states; each arm judged separately against G2 coverage_mix; no generalization claim

runtime_estimate.source: Actual G2 coverage_mix optimization throughput; estimate only
